Cost: 750eb (Expensive)
Class: Crossbow
Range: Shortbow
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Infrared Nightvision Scope (effects already included in these stats)

Fire 1 extra round to ablate 1 more SP (2 normally, 3 with Armor-Piercing). Its Extended Magazine can't be removed or replaced without destroying the weapon, and it only fires from that magazine, so no manual loading; once empty it needs a Reload Action.

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
